title: Record field (the 2-0 after one week)
finding: median game ON: each team plays its opponent and the league median every week. League setting league_average_match = 1; wins across all rosters = 12 after 1 week(s) (head-to-head only would give 6, with a median game 12).

title: DEF projection bias (Sleeper omits 3-and-outs and 4th-down stops)
finding: Week 1: across 32 defenses, actual minus projected averaged +0.63 (MAE 4.8). Points from the two unprojected categories averaged 1.56 per defense, which is the structural part of the bias. Among the 12 defenses actually started, bias was 0.2.

title: Completed-week detection
finding: Method: projection game dates. Completed 1, upcoming 2. v1.2 uses game dates from the projection rows, which stays correct on Friday through Monday when the v1.1 rule would flip early.

title: Projection formula
finding: Projected = Sleeper's projected stat line x this league's scoring, excluding projected return TDs (matches the Sleeper UI, verified week 1 by v1.1).
